notes: Phase 3: Layout Changes undo/redo. Added onUndoCommand callback to createLayoutHandlers for layout style changes (separate undo per change) and layout options (batched per interaction). Key discovery: Vue v-model updates data before @change/@input fires, so snapshot must be captured on @focus (select) or @pointerdown/@focus (range inputs). Added @pointerdown for touch device support and @focus for keyboard arrow-key support per world-review. Added early-exit guards to LayoutManager setters to prevent unnecessary regenerate() calls during undo. All 43 UndoExpansionTest tests pass, full suite (84 test files) passes with 0 failures.
